955-2023-4770-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2079-2137-4642.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2079-2137-4642.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

5310-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Bloodghast
When Bloodghast dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning Bloodghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
5310-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

6249-6495-7920--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6249-6495-7920--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-1115-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

1744-3487-5770-7824.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating ten token copies of Aetherstorm Roc.
When the Aetherstorm Roc tokens enter the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers ten times, causing you to get 110 {E}.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating a 6/6 Beast artifact creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers, causing you to get eleven {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

215-1115-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-1115-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6608-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
3532-5078-6608-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2034-3497-4871-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat.

224-654-2157-6973.description:
Cast Mutable Explorer by paying {2}{G}.
When Mutable Explorer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Mutavault land token.
When the Mutavault token enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Reoslve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the Mutavault token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Mutavault token.
Repeat from step 3.

413-3249-6586.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Vivi.
Cast Vivi by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Havengul Lich triggers, causing it to gain Vivi's activated abilities until end of turn.
Resolve Vivi. When it enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Vivi.
Activate Havengul Lich using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
413-3249-6586.notes: If Havengul Lich's power is 5 or higher, you'll get infinite red and blue mana.

1545-4186-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-4186-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

475-3197-4321-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-3197-4321-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2539-3094-4659-5223-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4659-5223-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

6738-6965-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
6738-6965-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2893-3875-6168-6763.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-1669-5671.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-5671.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size, one of which must be a land card.
250-779-1479-1669-5671.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard a land and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return a land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

2792-3647-6991.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2792-3647-6991.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Great Whale
When Donnie & April and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
2792-3647-6991.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

1818-2438-5010-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2438-5010-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

2313-4968-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Conclave Mentor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
2313-4968-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

1632-1987-4423-6918.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Stonespeaker Crystal by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Stonespeaker Crystal.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

24-1640-3901.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Wrathful Red Dragon instead of you due to Pariah's Shield if you chose the largest number.
Wrathful Red Dragon triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-1640-3901.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

488-874-4211-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of either Delif's Cone or Tormod's Crypt must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-874-4211-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3951-4050-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-4050-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

4636-5089-5395-6212.notablePrerequisites:
Piper has power 3 or greater, does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Karn has three or more loyalty counters on it.
4636-5089-5395-6212.description:
Cast Gonti's Aether Heart by paying {6}.
When Gonti's Aether Heart enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Piper. 
Piper triggers, creating at least three Clue tokens.
When the Clues enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers that many times, causing you to get {E}{E} for each Clue.
Activate Gonti's Aether Heart by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting Gonti's Aether Heart from exile into your hand. 
Activate a Clue by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
Piper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Clue ability, causing you to draw a card.
Teferi's Talent triggers, putting a loyalty counter on Karn.
Move to your next turn.
During your draw step, you will draw a card. When you do, Teferi's Talent triggers, putting a loyalty counter on Karn.
Repeat.

2429-3193-4365.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
2429-3193-4365.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

942-1778-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {C}{C}.
When Memnite dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted, adding {C}{C}.
When Samwise the Stouthearted dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Samwise the Stouthearted from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Samwise the Stouthearted enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand, and causing the Ring to tempt you.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1368-2499-3538-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three cards in your graveyard.
1368-2499-3538-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gnawing Vermin, adding {B}.
Gnawing Vermin dies, triggering its second ability, causing target creature you don't control to get -1/-1 until end of turn.
Cast Gnawing Vermin from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Gnawing Vermin enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability twice, causing you to mill four cards.
Repeat.

282-3073-3724-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina and Lightning Runner.
282-3073-3724-4918.description:
Declare Delina and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering their abilities twice each.
Resolve a Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Aethertorch Renegade that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
The Aethertorch Renegade token(s) enters the battlefield, causing you to get at least {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve the second Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of any creature you control that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Resolve the first Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.

643-1636-3413-4117.notablePrerequisites: Visara does not have summoning sickness.
643-1636-3413-4117.description:
Activate Visara by tapping it, destroying any creature you control.
The creature dies, triggering Xathrid Necromancer, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1908-4251.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
1908-4251.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating a token copy of Godo with haste.
Put the nontoken Godo into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Godo enters the battlefield, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Declare the token Godo as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Godo triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

622-2757-3467.notablePrerequisites: Darksteel Garrison attached to an untapped basic land.
622-2757-3467.description:
Pay {1}{G} to Kamahl, targeting the basic land.
Tap the fortified land with Earthcraft, untapping itself.
Darksteel Garrison triggers giving any creature +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1283-3138-3977.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Horned Kavu.
Pay for Talisman to untap Chromatic Orrery.
Return Horned Kavu to hand using its ability.

413-628-4907.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
When Tatterkite dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with zero +1/+1 counters due to its ability.
When Tatterkite enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
